initial.prompt: Create a finished AI-painted distant SKYLINE TEXTURE for the game 猫国志, a rainy dark cyberpunk CAT metropolis. A wide full-canvas panorama, aspect ratio exactly 2:1, high-resolution 4096x2048 working artwork intended for a 2048x1024 texture export. No frame, border, title, typography, label, watermark, signature, poster mockup or ground-level street scene. This artwork wraps on the INSIDE of a distant cylinder around a 3D city: left and right sides must connect naturally and seamlessly. At both left and right outer edges use the SAME low-contrast violet atmospheric haze and compatible low rooftop heights; avoid a bright line, abruptly cut tower, half billboard or isolated high-contrast light at either seam. Do not mirror the whole composition or repeat a big distinctive centerpiece. The upper 28 percent is empty, quiet, nearly uniform very dark plum-purple night sky (#140d25), smoothly blending downward into layered violet atmospheric mist; no moon, sun, stars, orange sunset, white sky or vivid bright clouds. The bottom edge fades toward near-black violet, with no bright horizon line. Huge dark silhouettes of futuristic skyscrapers at varying heights, layered depth, a few connecting enclosed skyways, sparse window groups and restrained tiny cyan, magenta and coral lights. Small aerial vehicles appear only as tiny colored light streaks in the middle-distance, not prominent foreground ships. A few faint rectangular holographic ad halos, abstract feline/pointed-ear symbols only, no writing, human face, human body, real brand or portrait. Strong readable tower silhouettes with rounded or beveled industrial shapes, painted game-background character, not a realistic city photograph. No foreground people, cats, street, road, wet pavement, close buildings or dominant perspective vanishing-point corridor. Keep all major towers completely visible inside the image, below the upper empty sky. Dark city mass and negative sky space dominate, with luminous accents making no more than a small fraction of the area. Composition A: broad asymmetrical skyline with a slim tiered antenna tower slightly left of center, a pair of medium stepped towers on the right, three subtly glowing suspended walkways at different heights, and several smaller layers fading into rainy haze. Main color accents cyan; magenta is secondary. Dense but quiet, monumental scale, distant city as one atmospheric silhouette band.

edit.prompt: Edit this existing 2:1 panoramic dark cyberpunk CAT-city skyline texture. Keep the same 1774x887 framing, dark plum/cyan/magenta palette, tower silhouettes, cat-symbol holographic billboards, windows, walkways and small lights. Repair ONLY the vertical discontinuity at the EXACT CENTER of the canvas (x about 887): this center line currently joins two different halves of the same panorama, leaving an abrupt vertical change in the violet sky and mist plus mismatched rooftop/skybridge features below. Repaint a narrow vertical band around that center join, approximately the central 18 percent of the width across the full height, so the sky gradient, atmospheric haze, dark city mass, rooftop contours and a skyway connect smoothly and naturally across the old line. Do not place any visual line, wall, pole, central division or new billboard on the seam. Preserve the LEFTMOST and RIGHTMOST 35 percent of the image as closely as possible; their existing edges are already a continuous natural join from adjacent pixels in the original picture and must remain seamless when this texture repeats around a cylinder. Keep the upper quiet very dark purple sky smooth and uncluttered, without sun, moon, stars, bright clouds or text. Keep the bottom near-black mist fade. Do not replace the city with a street view, add any human or human face, sharpen every window, alter the aspect ratio, mirror the panorama, invent letters or brighten the whole scene. This is a local AI seam repair of the supplied image, not a new composition.

selection_reason: Candidate 2 has stronger readable silhouettes, restrained windows and open dark-purple sky. After exact horizontal half-offset, image_gen repaired the former outer seam at the center; the edited offset image is used without rolling it back.

export.transform: Uniform Lanczos resample; no crop, padding, color adjustment, procedural skyline painting or manual seam blend
export.resolution_note: The image-generation tool returned 1774x887 despite the larger resolution requested in the prompt. Final required 2048x1024 is an approximately 15.44% upsample, not claimed as native 2048x1024.
